xBRIEFInfo.description: Enrichment state field and filter (schema v18)

plan.title: Add enrichment state so actors needing human attention can be found

narratives.Overview: There is no way to filter actors by whether external enrichment matched them, failed to match them, or produced a disagreement a human must settle.
narratives.Problem: A single enrichment run left 210 actors needing human attention with no way to find any of them in the app: 157 no match, 45 ambiguous, 8 disagreements withheld. That list lives only in a log file. The app cannot surface its own unfinished work, and the number grows with every run.
narratives.Action:
Schema v18 adds three nullable columns:
- enrichmentState: matched / noMatch / ambiguous / needsReview
- enrichmentSource: the provider's display name, supplied at RUNTIME (data, not code)
- enrichmentCheckedAt: distinguishes 'never attempted' (nil) from 'attempted, no match'

Surface as a filter in the data-repair accordion alongside missing photo and missing gender.
narratives.Constraint:
CRITICAL - the field, its column, its migration and its UI labels must NOT name any external source. This lands in the public repository, and column names survive in migrations and in every backup archive permanently.

The field records THAT enrichment ran and WHAT it concluded, never which provider concluded it. A second provider must reuse it with no schema change; if it cannot, the abstraction has failed.

nil state is NOT noMatch. Conflating them makes every un-enriched actor look like a failure.
narratives.Risk: Schema v17 added five columns and was silently dropped in FOUR places that reconstruct an EntityProfile field-by-field: ActorLibraryPackage (data loss on library merge), ActorSync (never synced), the profile editor (ERASED on Save, with no error), and MergeSemantics (vanished from the federated view). v18 will hit all four again. Each has a regression test now - make them fail first.
narratives.Test:
An actor never attempted is distinguishable from one attempted without a match.
The filter finds all 210 of the current backlog and empties as they are resolved.
The repository-hygiene check passes - nothing names an external source.
A second provider populates the same field with no migration.

items.title: Add three nullable columns as migration v18
Carry them through ActorLibraryPackage, ActorSync, the editor and MergeSemantics
Batch and in-app paths write the state
Filter entry in the data-repair accordion
Decide whether needsReview clears itself on manual edit
